function_v0.doc:
A2: an LP of the union accepts at the attester's fix (the rate is fixed now), with the anchor's
signed quote (C9b): NotAnchor without a swap key, QuoteExpired after `valid_until`,
QuoteChanged when today's `lp_quote` no longer gives `usdc`; a bad signature traps (host
error, no contract error code). A Collect locks the LP's new USDC in the LP's account; a
Bring reserves the union's USDC it opens (NoUsdc when short). One accepted offer per LP.
function_v0.name: accept

function_v0.doc: The anchor accepts or drops a member as LP of her union (R20): she must hold a title\nthe union minted.
function_v0.name: set_lp

function_v0.doc:
A1b / A7b: the leader scanned and counted; everything moves as fixed at accept.
Collect: the rupees leave the cash at hand; the LP's account pays the closed and the new
USDC into fx_pool (closed \xe2\x86\x92 the union's, new \xe2\x86\x92 held for the LP). Bring: the rupees less the
fee join the cash at hand (a 7-day escrow; the fee from the treasury); the closed USDC goes
back to the LP free, the reserved union USDC to the LP's account, locked.
function_v0.name: confirm

function_v0.doc: USDC held in fx_pool for the union's LPs' Collect positions (31 Oct; before, the C5b\nswaps' LP USDC, which nothing adds to now).
function_v0.name: lp_usdc

function_v0.doc: What `lp` accepting a `kind` offer of `inr` rupees does at today's fix: the USDC it closes\nand opens, and the close fee (the anchor signs `usdc`).
function_v0.name: lp_quote

event_v0.name: PositionSettled

function_v0.doc:
The leader scanned rupees in (C6, L10, N11). `scan_hash` (the photo count's receipt) is
only published in the CashScanned event, never stored (executive decision 24 Oct: the
leader counting the notes is the trust signal; a stored receipt was rent for nothing).
Invest, repay and recovery open a 7-day escrow on the union's cash at
hand, which may not exceed its treasury (R15). A repay larger than what she owes
mints only what is owed; the leader hands back the change. Returns the escrow id.
Treasury is refused (22 Oct): counted cash never goes into the treasury.
function_v0.name: cash_scan_mint

function_v0.doc:
The signed cash-out (executive decision 24 Oct; a machine owner's income): her QR carries her
authorisation of (union, amount), used once by its Soroban nonce, expiring at its ledger (~48 h); any
leader of her union scans it once the notes are handed over and submits. Her nIN is clawed back
(fx_pool is the nIN admin) and the rupees leave the union's cash at hand. No escrow, no code.
function_v0.name: cash_out_signed

function_v0.doc: The senior contract only (2 Nov): `nin` minted into the union's senior pool in `investor`'s name, for\nUSDC the senior contract took in (or, for the vault, holds) at the fix. fx_pool holds no senior USDC.
function_v0.name: mint_senior_nin

function_v0.doc: R10 around a fund_core payout (claim, treasury withdrawal). Authorising needs a\ntitle the union minted or a leader of the union (C3).
function_v0.name: set_member_auth

function_v0.doc: USDC in a union's leader-swap bucket (swap_usdc_to_nin less swap_nin_to_usdc).
function_v0.name: leader_swap_usdc

function_v0.doc: Back: her nIN is burned and USDC at the rate is paid only from the union's leader-swap bucket (never the LP,\nsenior or treasury USDC), and never more than she swapped in herself and has not swapped back (review 5 Nov:\nowner income or other nIN goes out by the desk, `cash_out_signed`); refused (`NoUsdc`) when either is short.
function_v0.name: swap_nin_to_usdc

function_v0.doc: A leader's own swap, USDC \xe2\x86\x92 nIN in her wallet (executive decision 22 Oct): a leader of the union whose identity\nthe anchor checked; since 4 Nov also a title holder of the union in self mode, `leader` = her account. Her USDC stays in fx_pool, in the union's leader-swap bucket, as the backing of that nIN.
function_v0.name: swap_usdc_to_nin

function_v0.doc: Raising applies at once and voids a filed lowering; lowering applies only when set again\nafter the current delay, within 7 days; at most 30 days.
function_v0.name: set_upgrade_delay

function_v0.doc: Anyone, after expiry: the union kept rupees it neither lent nor settled, so the same\namount of its treasury nIN is burned in fund_core (R15).
function_v0.name: burn_expired_escrow

function_v0.doc:
A leader adds USDC to her union's treasury (executive decision 22 Oct): the USDC stays in
fx_pool as the backing, and the same value in nIN at the attester's rate goes into the
union treasury in fund_core. The only way, besides a leader's own nIN, that the treasury
grows. Same cap per call as a scan. Returns the nIN minted.
function_v0.name: deposit_usdc_treasury
